address: 126 Ratchadamnoen Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima, Nakhon Ratchasima, 30000, Thailand
bio: At this rotisserie stall, they have spent over 50 years perfecting their signature dish of chicken (farmed or domestic) marinated in a secret peppery, herbal blend before it hits the spit. Juicy and tender, with a thin skin, the meat comes served with a sweet chilli dipping sauce....
